vote.summary: The candidate is a self-consistent, decision-scoped RAG v2 plan: additive pgvector schema with dimension preflight, deterministic cl100k chunking, batched embedding worker with lease recovery, RRF hybrid retrieval, hash-only query-embedding cache, and a single authorized snapshot reused by two same-model agents. Rollout, gates, observability, failure tests, rollback, and an option ledger are present; unknowns are honestly retained and the envelope matches its stated byte length and digest.
requirements_covered: Implement lexical/vector hybrid retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion using pre-limit security predicates in FTS and vector SQL
Add a parallel chunked v2 pgvector table and retain v1 for fallback/rollback with additive reversible schema
Use deterministic ranking/authority/diversity, with no LLM or separate-model reranker
Cache only query embeddings in PostgreSQL, never complete retrieval results, with TTL, bounded row limit, and live authorization on every hit
Persist one short-lived authorized context snapshot per AI job for the triage agent and conditional resolution/review agent, reused by both without rerunning retrieval

Dimension contract: preflight matches existing v1 embedding dimension to validated TICKET_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS and aborts on absence/mismatch; future model changes create v3, never in-place alteration
Deterministic chunking with explicit tiktoken cl100k_base identity, split order, bootstrap/max/overlap limits, and non-silent oversized-source handling
Chunk ID via SHA256 over scope/source/parent/chunk index/identity; transactional replacement with corpus generation increment and no provider call in that transaction
Delete or invalidate chunks on source deletion/archival/private/portal-evidence/approval changes; model-generated text never indexed
Batched embedding worker with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED leases, bounded attempts, batch splitting, content/identity predicate before updates, and dead-letter visibility
Hybrid retrieval with parallel FTS/vector paths in independent sessions, RRF formula, tie-break order, per-parent/per-ticket caps, KB reservations, and 6-10 passage window
Degradation semantics: vector/provider/cache failure degrades to lexical; DB/authorization failure fails closed; no full retrieval-result cache
Security invariants: metadata JSON never upgrades authority; scope_key never caller-supplied; live auth/content-hash recheck before snapshot reuse; telemetry uses safe IDs/hashes/classes only
Rollout with v1 authoritative phases, shadow reads, canary, cutover, one-click feature-flag rollback, and separately gated v1 retirement
Release gates and observability: relevance, latency, freshness, zero stale/unauthorized evidence, production-shaped 100k test and 1M synthetic test before external infra
Failure-injection list and stop-promotion criteria covering authorization/stale evidence, dimension mismatch, relevance/latency regression, budget overrun, and rollback drill
Option ledger with decisions A-G4 and retained unknowns explicitly marked as bootstrap values to be replaced by measurement
Out-of-scope boundaries respected: no code changes, no second model/reranker, no DB replacement without evidence, no autonomous remediation, no capacity/relevance claims
implementation_options: Hybrid retrieval algorithm: RRF pooled lexical/vector adopted; same-LLM rerank deferred; separate reranker rejected; no raw-score comparison
Storage topology: parallel additive chunked v2 with v1 retained; in-place v1 alteration rejected; external vector DB deferred until measured pgvector failure at production-shaped scale
Caching strategy: PostgreSQL query-embedding cache adopted; local L1 query cache optional/deferred; full retrieval-result cache deferred/rejected
Agent evidence reuse: single immutable snapshot adopted; generated output never appended/indexed; snapshot revalidation required before reuse
Embedding worker: narrow durable per-chunk leases adopted; broader ai_jobs system deliberately not a dependency
details_checked: Migration 0008 preflight reads existing v1 column dimension and aborts on absence/mismatch; dimension/chunker identity recorded in rag_v2_schema_meta

Unique (scope_key, source_type, source_id, parent_hash, chunk_index), CHECK chunk_index >= 0, bounded content/metadata/error fields, HNSW vector_cosine_ops and GIN simple tsvector preserving v1 config
Partial queue and expired-lease indexes for queued/running states; lease owner/expiry/attempts fields
Cache key includes scope_key/query_hash/embedding_identity/dimensions, stores no raw query, TTL 45 minutes, bounded row limit, periodic deletion; hits still perform live retrieval authorization
Snapshot contains bounded redacted excerpts, exact chunk IDs/content hashes/citations/digest; default expiry is min(job retention, 24h)
Corpus generation incremented in same transaction as chunk replacement and auth-relevant source changes
Chunking split order (headings, paragraphs, sentences, token windows), 450/600/50 limits, single chunk for short content, per-source caps 16/8/128
FTS can see fresh text during the lag while vector search ignores null embeddings; delayed results cannot resurrect stale evidence
Worker claims up to 32 chunks with SKIP LOCKED, commits before provider call, expired-lease recovery, max two attempts with jitter, toxic-item batch splitting with independent commits
Delayed/wrong-dimension/stale-identity results are discarded or requeued; update predicate checks chunk id, hashes, eligibility/revision, embedding identity, and active lease
Retrieval uses independently owned short-lived sessions, asyncio.to_thread, no shared SQLAlchemy session across threads/tasks, no open request transaction during provider call
Separate bootstrap pools 40/40 ticket/comment and 16/16 KB; RRF denominator 60 + rank; tie-break by dual-signal presence, authority priority, best rank, stable tuple
Dedup normalized passages with per-parent/per-ticket caps and reserved KB passages; final 6-10 passage window
Facade file placement, settings/env/Helm flags, CI pgvector integration job, benchmark script, docs, and rollback feature-flag flip are specified

Observability covers cache hit/miss/age, batch utilization, queue depth/retry/dead letter, index lag, v1-v2 divergence, query latencies, HNSW/GIN sizes, DB CPU/IO/locks, prompt tokens, and LLM latency separately
vote.proposed_artifact: No replacement needed: the canonical candidate already contains the decision, schema/dimension contract, chunking and lifecycle rules, worker semantics, hybrid retrieval algorithm, snapshot reuse contract, file map, rollout/rollback, gates, failure tests, option ledger, and honestly retained unknowns.
